comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Gas producer and power generator selling commodities; not a compressor rental or fabrication business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Makes and rents wellheads and frac pressure control equipment for well completions; different products and a more drilling-linked business than gas compression.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Rents downhole drilling tools to drillers; shares the rental model but serves drilling, not compression of produced gas.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Specialty oilfield chemicals and analytics sold as products; no equipment rental or compression.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mostly rents mobile power generation to data centers and utilities, plus proppant handling equipment; different from gas compression.
